##### Project general facts

Rove Home Meydan Horizon is a branded residential tower by Rove Hotels, a joint venture between Emaar Properties and Dubai Holding, created for hassle-free, lifestyle-led living. A contemporary high-rise with smoothly rounded corners, a clean vertical facade, panoramic glazing and flowing balconies gives the building a light, dynamic silhouette. The tower rises above a basement, a ground floor and a three-level podium to twenty residential floors, offering fully furnished one- and two-bedroom apartments with canal views.

Amenities are designed for wellness, work and social life. Residents can swim in the pool, relax on the pool deck, cabanas and sun deck, and recharge in the jacuzzi and steam room. A gym, an outdoor exercise area, outdoor yoga and a running track support an active routine. The Rove Cafe, a co-working space and terrace, working pods and meeting rooms make working from home easy, while a residents' lounge, an outdoor cinema, a gaming room, a putting green and a multifunctional room add entertainment.

Each fully furnished apartment is full of character and easy to live in, with smart layouts, stylish finishes and vibrant interiors designed to spark creativity and movement. Comfortable sofas, statement lighting and fully equipped kitchens mean residents can move straight in, while balconies extend living spaces outdoors. Round-the-clock concierge and reception, free Wi-Fi in public spaces and the Rove Connect app give access to housekeeping, laundry, maintenance and a wide range of personal and lifestyle services.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is one of Dubai's most connected residential neighbourhoods, set between Downtown Dubai and the city's major road network. The area is known for its lagoon, landscaped canals, cycling tracks and golf course, together with the Meydan Racecourse and a growing lifestyle hub of retail, dining and leisure attractions, creating a calm, green setting close to the city centre for residents and families.

Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road provide quick connections across the city. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and Dubai International Financial Centre are a short drive away, while Dubai International Airport, Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina are within easy reach. Schools, clinics, supermarkets and shopping centres serve residents across Meydan and the surrounding districts, while the lagoon and cycling tracks offer space for outdoor activity close to home.

Meydan is a freehold area with strong appeal for professionals, young families and investors seeking a central address close to Downtown Dubai. Fully furnished branded apartments under an internationally recognised hospitality name attract premium tenants and short-stay guests, supporting attractive rental yields for owners and investors. Continued development of the district's lagoon and leisure offer strengthens long-term value and resale prospects.
